sections.Profile:
"Panthera" is a pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in June 1980. It features a solid-state design with two flippers, no ramps, and no multiball mode. The game is part of the Gottlieb System 80 series and showcases artwork by Doug Watson. A total of 5,220 units were produced.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1980–1985
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Roller Coaster, Women, Original Theme, Solid State, Widebody, Theme park, Animals, Fantasy, 1980s
